::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 12th 1864  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS University of Sheffield Library
:::

Dear Madam,
I have read the papers you enclosed with much interest but I am afraid that I can hardly make them available at the present time.[^1] They are written so much in the style of the former generation that they would hardly suit this one, excepting the Rivers, and that is too much of a fragment. With many thanks therefore I return them

yours faithfully
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: CMY judges them unsuitable for *[MP*.](organizations/other_52.qmd)
